paras: Angel's dwarf gecko (Lygodactylus decaryi) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Madagascar.
The specific name, decaryi, is in honor of French botanist Raymond Decary.
L. decaryi is found in southern Madagascar.
The preferred natural habitat of L. decaryi is savanna, at an altitude of 400 m (1,300 ft).
